question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

The researchers

P. decision centers called the orbitofrontal

Q. analyzed the electrical activity recorded

R. cortex and dorsal anterior cingulate cortex

S. from neurons in two of the brain's
solution:
Here the correct answer is **QSPR.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first part would be** Q **as it contains the verb 'analyzed' which would come after the noun 'researchers'.
 
• Also, it merges well with the introductory part.
 
• The second part would be **S** as it mentions from where the electrical activity was recorded i.e. from neurons.
 
• The third part would be** P** as it mentions the location in which the electrical activity was recorded i.e. brain's decision centers.
 
• The fourth part would be **R** as it mentions the names of the centers.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

**Correct Sequence:**__ *The researchers **analyzed the electrical activity recorded from neurons in two of the brain's decision centers called the orbitofrontal cortex and dorsal anterior cingulate cortex.***
